fact: The interior ministry mobilised DZD 664 million to generalise the national addressing reference (RNA) in a first phase in the pilot wilayas of Bouira, Sidi Bel Abbès, Ouargla and Constantine, with a national addressing committee set up, as announced on 11 May 2025.
title: 664 millions de dinars pour généraliser le Référentiel national d'adressage à l'échelle nationale
